title: Bud Hopkins videotaped on UFOs dragging us into 21st-century science

tellings.quote: having a recording of him from 1987 or something. I videotaped him for a documentary and he said eufology or UFOs are are dragging us kicking and screaming into the science of the 21st century

plain: In about 1987 Budd Hopkins, a researcher known for working with people who say they were abducted, said on camera that UFOs "are dragging us kicking and screaming into the science of the 21st century." The writer and filmmaker Greg Bishop says he recorded this himself while filming Hopkins for a documentary. He brings it up as an early sign of the belief that the subject would push science forward.
